name: Optical and Quantum Electronics
description: Introduction: review of electromagnetic waves. Light propagation in anisotropic media: plane waves in an anisotropic media, refractive index, polarized light, birefringence, dielectric constant tensor, index ellipsoid. Manipulating light: negative refractive index, metamaterials, photonic crystals and photonic metamaterials and their applications (superlensing, cloaking, antenna, absorbers, sensors and optical filters). Modulating optical properties: Electro-optic effect: phase and amplitude modulators, switches; acousto-optic effect: modulator, tunable filters, deflector, scanner and spectrum analyser. Electro optics of liquid crystals; liquid crystal devices and spatial light modulators. Nonlinear optical effects (basics): second order and third order nonlinearities; second harmonic generation; sum and difference frequency generation; parametric amplification and parametric oscillation; third order nonlinear optical effects; self phase modulation.; cross phase modulation; four wave mixing, chirped pulses and solitons. Quantum sources and processes based on NLO techniques: single and entangled photon sources and their applications in quantum communication, quantum computation, quantum networks and quantum radar, etc.
